decision_conditions:
All recommended mitigation measures set out in the Acoustic Report and Noise Survey approved under 2010/1852 shall be retained and subsequently, the D1 education use hereby approved shall be operated in strict accordance with the details set out in the Acoustic Report and Noise Survey approved under 2010/1852 at all times.

REASON: In order to protect the amenity of neighbouring residential occupiers.
The premises shall only be used for the purpose of education and shall not be used for any other use falling within Use Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987. 

REASON: Other uses within Use Class D1 may give rise to unacceptable impacts on nearby residential amenity by reason of noise and disturbance, or traffic and parking in the vicinity of the site associated with such uses, and will therefore require a new planning application to allow appropriate assessment of such potential impacts.
description: Retention of flexible office (B1) and/or education use (D1) at ground to third floors inclusive.
